title: コモンズ・RELAY R2 操作面
description: 架空のDJコントローラー用の操作面。UVを画像に合わせて使用する非タイル素材。 ベースカラー画像のみ。Clampで使用。シームレス反復には対応しません。
descriptionEn: Original fictional DJ panel artwork. Non-tileable; match your mesh UVs to the image. Base color only. Use Clamp. This atlas does not support seamless tiling.
author: Xenoah

provenance.method: Original AI-generated cafe texture, copied byte-for-byte from its recorded source
provenance.rights: Xenoah original image. On 2026-10-14 the owner authorized its publication in the CC-BY-4.0 Meshcopia library. No third-party photograph or texture is included.
provenance.changes: Original PNG is unchanged. A separate resized WebP thumbnail and metadata were added. Original Clamp sampling is retained.
provenance.generationBrief: RELAY R2 fictional DJ controller. Flat 2:1 black printed panel, cyan and amber waveforms, two jogs, four-channel mixer with EQ/fader markings and cue/play/performance pads. Raised geometry matches artwork UVs.

usage: Clampで使用。シームレス反復には対応しません。
usageEn: Use Clamp. This atlas does not support seamless tiling.
